learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose About67% then locked; alternatives About94%,100%.
observations.exploration: Peak(R0 3):day19,65% had it,30% sick. Day100:94%,0% sick. R0 2 atday100:80%; R0 4:98%. Buttons remain labeled R0 3 while alternative radio selected.
observations.reveal: Not quite About94%; threshold means fewer than one new infection, not stopping. Still-sick30% continue transmission. Explicit made-up/random-mixing/lasting-immunity/no-behaviour-change/vaccine/treatment limitations. Reveal describes R0 3 while graph currently R0 4.
observations.visual: CUA screenshot peak: grid green/pink/empty dots and dashed67% threshold, legend, slider and R0 controls; legible dark1257x936; lower reveal button near bottom.
observations.chrome: No-history preview banner verified. Visible trust-count ignored; trust panel unopened.
